lines.rom: sri guru carana citalaya ke dharem dhyana hanumana balaji calisa likhe dasa snehi kalyana
visva vidita vara dani samkata harana hanumana maimhadipura mem pragata bhaye balaji bhagavana
jaya hanumana balaji deva pragata bhaye yaham tinom deva
pretaraja bhairava balavana kotavala kaptani hanumana
maimhadipura avatara liya hai bhaktom ka uddhara kiya hai
balarupa pragate haim yaham para samkata vale ate jaham para
dakani sakani aru jindanim masana curaila bhuta bhutanim
jake bhaya te saba bhaga jate syane bhope yaham ghabarate
cauki bandhana saba kata jate duta mile ananda manate
sacca hai darabara tihara sarana pare sukha pave bhara
rupa teja bala atulita dhama sanmukha jinake siya rama
kanaka mukuta mani teja prakasa sabaki hovata purna asa
mahanta ganesapuri gunile bhaye susevaka rama ramgile
adbhuta kala dikhai kaisi kalayuga jyoti jalai jaisi
umci dhvaja pataka nabha mem svarna kalasa haim unnata jaga mem
dharma satya ka damka baje siyarama jaya samkara raje
ana phiraya mugadara ghota bhuta jinda para parate sota
rama laksmana siya hrdaya kalyana bala rupa pragate hanumana
jaya hanumanta hathile deva puri parivara karata haim seva
laddu curama misri meva arji darakhasta lagau deva
daya kare saba vidhi balaji samkata harana pragate balaji
jaya baba ki jana jana ucare kotika jana tere aye dvare
bala samaya ravi bhaksahi linha timira maya jaga kinho tinha
devana vinati ki ati bhari chamra diyo ravi kasta nihari
lamghi udadhi siya sudhi laye laksmana hita samjivana laye
ramanuja prana divakara samkara suvana mam amjani cakara
kesari nandana dukha bhava bhamjana ramananda sada sukha sandana
siya rama ke prana piyare jaba baba ki bhakta ucare
samkata dukha bhamjana bhagavana daya karahu he krpa nidhana
sumara bala rupa kalyana kare manoratha purna kama
asta siddhi nava nidhi datari bhakta jana ave bahu bhari
meva aru misthana pravina bhaimta carhavem dhani aru dina
nrtya kare nita nyare nyare riddhi siddhiyam jake dvare
arji ka adesa milate hi bhairava bhuta pakarate tabahi
kotavala kaptana krpani pretaraja samkata kalyani
cauki bandhana katate bhai jo jana karate haim sevakai
ramadasa bala bhagavanta maimhadipura pragate hanumanta
jo jana balaji mem ate janma janma ke papa nasate
jala pavana lekara ghara jate nirmala ho ananda manate
krura kathina samkata bhaga jave satya dharma patha raha dikhave
jo sata patha kare calisa tapara prasanna hoya bagisa
kalyana snehi sneha se gave sukha samrddhi riddhi siddhi pave
manda buddhi mama janake ksama karo gunakhana samkata mocana ksamahu mama dasa snehi kalyana
